shared_component_exceptions.reason: Own PDF p17 prints F0/F1/F2/F3 as four individually ruled code cells with a single corrective-measures cell spanning four rows. HB-TABLE-TROUBLESHOOTING accepts code/measures pairs only and has no rowspan field. Preserve this printed table as native rowspan=4 cells using shared native manual-table grid and hb-troubleshooting frame styles; this exception does not cover any layout table.

Own PDF p5 prints a solid white warning-triangle asset inside all four signal labels, including NOTE and TIP. HB-TABLE-SYMBOL-SIGNAL offers show_icon boolean but no icon asset slot and substitutes a different Unicode outline glyph. Native printed signal table uses shared symbol styles plus the retained exact approved source triangle asset; no layout table is excepted.
